title: Temple Furnishings

questions.question: What was the first item made of bronze described in this chapter?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:1 (ESV): "He made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long..."

questions.question: What was the large water basin called?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:2 (ESV): "Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round..."

questions.question: Who was the sea for?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:6 (ESV): "...and the sea was for the priests to wash in."

questions.question: How many golden lampstands were made?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:7 (ESV): "And he made ten golden lampstands..."

questions.question: How many tables were made?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:8 (ESV): "He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple..."

questions.question: How many golden bowls were made?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:8 (ESV): "...And he made a hundred basins of gold."

questions.question: What did the ten washbasins wash?
options: What was used for the burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: What was used for the burnt offering
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:6 (ESV): "...In these they were to rinse off what was used for the burnt offering..."

questions.question: What material were the pots, shovels, and meat forks made of?
Where did the king cast the bronze items?
options: In the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zeredah
questions.correctAnswer: In the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zeredah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:17 (ESV): "In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah."

questions.question: Why was the weight of the bronze not found out?
options: Because Solomon made all these things in great quantities
questions.correctAnswer: Because Solomon made all these things in great quantities
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:18 (ESV): "Solomon made all these things in great quantities, for the weight of the bronze was not sought."

questions.question: What was the capacity of the Sea?
What was the thickness of the Sea?
How many courts did he make?
options: The court of the priests and the great court
questions.correctAnswer: The court of the priests and the great court
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:9 (ESV): "He made the court of the priests and the great court..."

questions.question: What happened to the doors of the court?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:9 (ESV): "...and overlaid their doors with bronze."

key_verse_text: Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round, ten cubits from brim to brim, and five cubits high, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.
